theme: Light theme preferred for business project sheet clarity with high-contrast slate borders, dark mode support togglable
design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast meets Precision Construction (Archetype 4 & Archetype 1 Hybrid)

typography.h1_hero: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
typography.section_eyebrow: text-xs font-mono font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

key_functionalities: Sign-in page with Google button, email/password form, and direct interactive quick-login buttons for demo accounts (Organizer GC, Electrical Partner A, HVAC Partner B)
Project sheet UI with a 4-step task stepper showing ONE active current task and ONE primary call to action
Task 1 - Check this job: Manual intake form (12 branch retrofit sites, dates, scope, $180k ceiling, own crew capacity) + gap analysis highlighting missing data as 'Unknown'

Task 2 - Prepare a draft: Schedule grid (sites x 3 weeks) with explicit Rule Checker list (Pass/Fail indicators for weekly capacity, 1 crew-week/site, deadlines, 1 scope owner/site, quoted limits, $180k ceiling)
Task 3 - Ask each partner: Focused partner cards with site/term visibility, direct link copy button, and partner review simulator modal/page
Partner Review Page/View: Private link route displaying ONLY partner's assigned sites and financial terms, with 3 explicit actions (Confirm, Request a change, Decline)
Task 4 - Decide next action: Partner status grid, before/after amendment diff view (comparing original terms vs partner requested modifications), action buttons (Discard / Select & Apply / Re-review)
History Drawer: Immutable timeline receipt ledger showing all intake entries, schedule rule checks, partner link generation, partner decisions, and amendment diff selections

component_guidelines.stepper: Clean technical horizontal bar with numbered nodes 1-4. Active step highlighted in solid primary slate with bold title and main action CTA banner.
component_guidelines.partner_card: Flat rectangular card with explicit status pill (Dot + Text), summary of assigned sites, fee ceiling, and private review link generator with quick copy & simulated partner view button.
component_guidelines.diff_viewer: Side-by-side or stacked split comparison grid with green highlights for additions, red strikethrough for removals, and amber tags for modified values.
component_guidelines.checker_list: Strict rule validation panel with explicit 'PASS' (green badge) or 'FAIL' (red badge) labels next to numerical details.
component_guidelines.history_drawer: Slide-over drawer from right displaying chronological timestamped events with author role badges (GC / Subcontractor) and detailed diff payloads.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive controls, step tabs, form inputs, partner action buttons, diff accept/reject toggles, and drawer controls MUST have unique kebabe-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure UI is structured as a calm, authoritative 'Project Sheet' rather than a standard crowded metric dashboard.
Always write out status terms explicitly next to color indicators (e.g. 'Confirmed' next to green dot, 'Action Needed' next to amber dot).
Include synthetic demo banner ('Synthetic Demo Data - 12 Branch Retrofits, $180k Ceiling') across the top sheet.
Provide clear feedback, loading states, empty state placeholders for unassigned sites, and error states on rule checks.
Ensure the Partner Review flow is fully functional and can be experienced both directly in place and via copied link route.
Follow strict data-testid conventions across all interactive elements.
